## reference · service-hailing-provider-tiers-uber-pro

- **Points system**  
  - Earn **1 point per completed trip** (including Uber Eats delivery trips).  
  **Bonus points** are awarded for trips taken during peak hours (exact bonus amount not disclosed).  
  - Points are tallied over a **fixed 3‑month period**; status for the next period is based on points earned in the prior period.

- **Status tiers & rewards**  
  | Tier | More earnings | Enhanced experience | Vehicle benefits | Lifestyle savings |
  |------|---------------|---------------------|------------------|-------------------|
  | **Blue** | – | – | ✓ | ✓ |
  | **Gold** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
  | **Platinum** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
  | **Diamond** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
  - **5 % earnings boost** (“Pro Perk”) applies to **Gold, Platinum, Diamond** drivers on eligible non‑premium rides.  
    - **California exception:** only Platinum and Diamond receive the boost.  
    - **Ineligible ride types:** Uber Black, Black SUV, Intercity, Premier, Premier SUV, Reserve, Hourly, Uber XShare, Uber Wait & Save, Uber WAV, airport‑originating requests, and any delivery trips (Uber Eats, Uber Connect).  
    - **Exclusions from the 5 % calculation:** promotions, tips, tolls, third‑party fees, and operational expenses shown on the receipt.

- **Cancellation‑rate rules**  
  - **4.01 % – 10 %** (for Gold/Platinum/Diamond): driver **cannot upgrade** to a higher tier but retains current tier and rewards.  
  - **> 10 %**: immediate loss of all Gold/Platinum/Diamond rewards; tier reverts to Blue until cancellation rate returns to **≤ 4 %**.

- **Star rating**  
  - Overall rating = average of individual rider ratings from the **most recent 500 trips**.  
  - A rating of **4 stars or below** on a trip that is “out of driver’s control” (e.g., GPS error, traffic) is **excluded** from the overall average.

- **Exclusive ride requests & Trip Radar Advantage**  
  - **Exclusive ride requests** are **not available** for the same ride types listed as ineligible for the 5 % earnings boost.  
  - **Trip Radar Advantage** matching (priority when multiple drivers are offered the same request) **excludes** delivery trips, Intercity, Wait & Save, Share, and Reserve rides.

- **Uber Pro Card (debit card)**  
  - Issued by **Evolve Bank & Trust**, a Mastercard debit card powered by Branch.  
  - **Cash‑back rates:**  
    - **Gas:** 2 % – 6 % (rate varies by tier).  
    - **EV charging:** 4 % – 12 % (rate varies by tier).  
  - **Maximum cash‑back:** **$100 per month** (excluding Mastercard Easy Savings cash‑back).  
  - **Eligibility for cash‑back:** purchase must be made **at the pump**; selecting “Debit” or entering a PIN **disqualifies** the transaction; “Credit” or “Bypass PIN” qualifies.  
  - **Easy Savings** may not be available in all locations.

- **Eligibility for Uber Pro**  
  - Drivers who **only deliver** via the Uber Eats app are **not eligible** for Uber Pro (they may qualify for Uber Eats Pro where offered).  
  - Drivers who **both drive and deliver** earn points for both ride and delivery trips.

- **Data handling**  
  - Uber processes personal data to calculate tier status and share necessary details with third‑party reward providers.  
  - Third‑party providers act as data controllers for data they receive; Uber remains the controller for status‑related data.

**Sources:** https://www.uber.com/us/en/drive/uber-pro/
